name: Voltaic Strategic Resources Limited
summary: Voltaic Strategic Resources Limited is a mineral explorer headquartered in West Perth that began in 2009 as Eon NRG Limited, with operations in Nevada and Western Australia. In Nevada's Stillwater Range it has a nickel-copper-cobalt project and the Gilberts mine, which holds silver, gold and lead. In Western Australia it owns 100% of several projects including Paddys Well.
